verdict.rationale: Square has a first-party 'Square Webhooks' documentation page [square-docs-12] and a Disputes API [square-docs-11], so outbound webhooks are a documented capability. The evidence is only page titles, though, with no detail on which payment events can be subscribed to. Missing for 10: documented payment lifecycle event types (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed), subscription/registration mechanics, signature verification and retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
